//: Example TTL-sentinel config. Copy to ttl-sentinel.config.json (untracked) and edit; pass with --config. Every field is optional and falls back to the defaults below, which are derived from the cliff model in src/cliff.ts.
//contractId: Deployed StreamPay contract id (C...). STREAMPAY_CONTRACT_ID overrides.
//scanIntervalSec: Wall seconds between scans. Worst-case scan gap is computed at floorLedgerSec (1 s), never at the 5 s target.
//statePath: Cache of the last counter value + seen addresses. Alerts and the spend meter live beside it as <statePath>.alerts.json and <statePath>.spender.json.
//alertsJsonlPath: Append alerts as JSON lines here (empty disables). Alert text always goes to stderr, so --json stdout stays machine-readable.
//webhookUrl: POST alert batches here (empty disables). TTL_SENTINEL_WEBHOOK_URL overrides.
//monitorContractEntries: Also watch the contract instance and Wasm code entries — never extended on-chain by the contract, so their cliff is 4095 ledgers (~5.7 h).
//maxStreams: Enumeration safety valve: stop after this many stream ids in one scan.
//counterFallbackProbeRun: When the counter entry is unreadable (archived), probe this many ids past the cached high-water mark to catch streams created during downtime.
//sorobanStateSizeBytes: Current live Soroban state size, for the rent curve. 0 (unknown) uses the CAP-0066 floor fee of 1000 stroops/KB; the fee scales to 10000 at the 3 GB target.
//reAlertEveryLedgers: Re-fire crit/expired alerts once per this many ledgers of observation age (8640 ≈ 12 h at 5 s/ledger).
//schedules: Per-class thresholds in ledgers REMAINING; warnLedgers must stay below the class cliff or scan refuses to run. stream/index are extended on-chain (worst-case cliff 200000 ledgers, extend-to 500000), so they warn at 75% of the cliff. counter/instance/code are never extended on-chain (cliff 4095 ledgers ≈ 5.7 h), so their thresholds sit far lower.
//extender: OPTIONAL funded component. Off by default; the core sentinel is read-only. `extend` is also dry-run unless --execute is passed.

extender.//secretKeyEnv: Env var holding the extender's Stellar secret key. Never a CLI flag (argv leaks via ps) and never read by `scan`.
extender.//thresholdLedgers: Only extend entries whose remaining TTL is below this.
extender.//extendTo: Extend target past the current ledger (a floor, not an exact value). Must exceed thresholdLedgers and stay under max_entry_ttl (6312000).
extender.//dryRun: Print the plan without submitting. --execute overrides per run.
extender.//monthlyBudgetXlm: Hard monthly cap on extension fees, enforced from the persisted spend meter.
